newsitem.title: UK: Freight trade continues to run at low ebb.
newsitem.headline: Freight trade continues to run at low ebb.

text.p: The volume of fixtures reported in the dry cargo freight market continues to be limited, despite the number of charters fixed on private terms and not publicised.
Brokers said there is little doubt that there has been a general decline in the turnover of tramp business.

The BFI lost another couple of points to 995 today, but although there is the potential for further weakness in the rates on most BFI routes brokers believe that owners cannot afford to trade at levels much lower than those currently prevailing.

The market is alert for news of defaults which would not be unexpected in present conditions, and there are rumours of banks doing more than expressing disquiet about the plight of some owner clients.

GRAIN - Dreyfus fixed another U.S. Gulf/Japan grain stem - 55/56,700 tonnes for Oct 15/25 at an unchanged $19.00 basis no combo. But U.S. Gulf/Continent rates for early Oct for which older tonnage is eligible appeared to weaken again.
Tradigrain were rumoured to have booked a vessel for 50,000 heavy grain at only $8.50 and Cargill were said to be trading a panamax at $8.00 against under $9.00, both for early Oct loading.

Bunge were believed to have declined Forum Cape at $8.50 for similar business. Elsewhere, grain markets were quiet although Andre introduced a fresh order for tonnage of 2-3m cft delivery East Coast South America Oct 10/20 for a trip to Singapore-Japan range.

MINERALS - Chartering enquiry is still weak. Sea Grace 158,000 dwt was understood fixed by P and O delivery UK end-Oct trip via Brazil to China and Georgios M 148,581 dwt by Pan Ocean delivery Skaw early Oct for the same trip, both on private terms.
Other Caper ironore fixtures which were not fully reported were Iron Master 127,774 dwt for Narvik/Antwerp to Cobelfret and Hydroussa 169,584 dwt Dampier/Beilun to CSG.
Coal business was reported fixed by Cobelfret with Excelsior 110,000/10 Baltimore/Rotterdam for Oct/Nov at $5.45 and by Iron Kembla 120,000 Port Kembla/Kaohsiung, said to be at $4.30.
In the Panamax category the 1976-built Menalon 66,464 dwt was fixed by Keoyang delivery Seward trip South Korea with coal at $5,600/5,700 daily plus $80,000 bonus.

Market rumours suggested Ossolineum 61,013 dwt fixed coal Richards Bay/Japan, Angelic Protector 77,761 dwt Richards Bay/Continent, and Transworld 71,761 dwt ironore Ponta Do Ubu/Cigading with Pan Ocean, but full details were lacking.

HANDYSIZES - Little news emerged from a poor market, although Dreyfus covered the 1985-built Tribuno 38,476 dwt delivery prompt Continent for a trip to the Far East at a fairly respectable $10,450 daily.

Oetker fixed a 25,000 dwt vessel from Hamburg to Brazil on private terms. In the Far East Kambara were linked with a 36,700 dwt craned bulker delivery North China for a trip via Japan to Singapore at $7,000 daily.
Pisces Explorer 38,584 dwt was fixed on private terms by Navix delivery NOC for a trip to South East Asia.
